observation.desktop: Live Amazon.co.jp page inspected in Chrome at 1440 x 1000; 15 gallery items and 8 major A+ containers recorded.

visual_patterns.visual_hierarchy: Sparse black headlines and calm product photography precede detailed workflow cards.
visual_patterns.information_density: Low to medium in gallery scenarios; high inside workflow and plan modules.
visual_patterns.image_text_ratio: About 70:30 in scenario units and 45:55 in software-output explanations.
visual_patterns.whitespace: Generous warm-neutral whitespace is a defining rhythm device.
visual_patterns.full_bleed_usage: Used selectively for video and lifestyle closure rather than every module.
visual_patterns.card_usage: Cards model inputs, outputs and workflow stages; they carry semantic sequence rather than decoration.
visual_patterns.product_scale: Dominant early and in physical-detail modules; deliberately small in outcome-led scenes.
visual_patterns.typography_hierarchy: Large restrained headline, short subcopy, small interface labels; calm and editorial.
visual_patterns.dark_light_rhythm: Mostly warm light with a dark video hero as the primary contrast break.
visual_patterns.scene_technical_rhythm: Category explanation alternates with realistic work scenes and output demonstrations.

strengths: 把新类别拆成输入—处理—成果—场景的清楚工作流
留白和暖中性色让复杂AI产品易读
大量真实工作场景帮助用户判断适配性
物理产品与软件价值交替出现
weaknesses: 图库15张且A+轮播数量多，路径过长
会员方案与AI功能说明密度高
品牌与利用规模Claim需要强证据
390px viewport下固定宽内容有裁切风险
use: 新类别先解释用户任务，再解释技术名词
以输入—处理—成果—场景作为AI产品骨架
用真实工作场景验证抽象的AI能力
用暖色留白降低高复杂度信息的压迫感
adapt: 所有UI必须来自官方素材并由Graphic Layer程序化排版
把轮播章节压缩为Amazon中可直接理解的静态信息单元
保留SwitchBot品牌的薄荷色与友好感，不复制Plaud米色Trade Dress
avoid: 直接复制Plaud文案、UI、卡片形状或米色视觉系统
在Gallery过早放入高密度会员表
使用未审核的No.1、用户规模或安全Claim
让AI功能列表代替消费者工作流
good_for: 价值来自硬件与软件连续工作流的产品
专业人群与多场景适配判断重要的页面
